Good morning, I used to take my two dogs to get their hair cut. They're schnauzers. At first, they always got their hair cut too short, but one day I took them and, lo and behold, they looked divine! The reason? A new Venezuelan groomer who did a fantastic job. Anyway, the last time I took them, they were cut too short again, and today when I took them back, I asked why. They told me that the groomer who used to cut their hair didn't come back. Well, I asked the owner who was going to cut their hair so they wouldn't get cut like last time, and he very rudely told me that he would, and that the cut he learned for schnauzers wasn't the one they needed, so he'd rather not do it. I understand that he might not know how to do it, but it was his arrogant attitude that I didn't like, as if to say, "Go somewhere else." I can only imagine his love for dogs.

On Saturday, I took my dog ​​to their grooming service. I travel an hour there because I liked the way they groomed her; the distance wasn't an obstacle for me. When I got home, I noticed my dog ​​was behaving abnormally and saw a burn on her private area. Since it was the weekend, I couldn't contact the grooming salon until Monday. I explained the situation, and they told me to bring her in. When I spoke with the owner, and he saw my dog, he said it could be from her being in heat, even though she hadn't been in heat for over two months. The grooming salon owner called a veterinarian, whom I assume they know, and the "doctor" told me it was from my dog ​​being in heat, even though they hadn't even examined her. The "doctor" gave her some pathetic cream, and the grooming salon owner didn't even want to cover the cost of an Elizabethan collar; he said I had to buy it myself. How disappointing the lack of professionalism from Cragin Animal Hospital is.

You don't have to be a veterinarian to know this wasn't due to her being in heat, and that it was more likely a cut or burn. Now my dog ​​is sad and suffering because of malpractice at this groomer's, and I don't know what disappoints me more: the dishonesty of the groomer or the vet.

I always took my dogs to this place, but after this, I won't be going back.
